grammar.summary: 本课学习动名词作主语与感知动词的实验叙事。

points.title: 动名词作主语
points.explanation: Seeing hands = 用手"看"。V-ing 短语作主语，谓语单数。本文标题即语法点。

examples.en: Seeing hands is not a fantasy.

points.title: make out 表辨认
points.explanation: She was able to distinguish colours by touch. distinguish A from B = 辨别；make out（勉强认出）是感知动词群成员。

examples.en: They can even distinguish different colours.
examples.cn: 她们甚至能辨别不同的颜色。
